operations.name: audio-transcripts
operations.description: Validate timestamped local transcripts, speakers, quote windows, and diarization sidecars without audio decoding.

operations.name: bibliographic
operations.description: Parse and validate BibTeX, RIS, CSL JSON, identifiers, conflicts, and citation metadata caches.

operations.name: citations
operations.description: Extract inline, footnote, and bibliography citations; align quotes; build anchors; and validate citation completeness.

operations.name: composition
operations.description: Create a grounded, deterministic long-form draft from retrieved evidence with section-level citations and coherence checks.

operations.name: deduplication
operations.description: Detect exact and near duplicates, cluster them, and select a canonical record using authority, status, and date.

operations.name: deployment
operations.description: Validate offline bundles, record an environment baseline, and emit install, rollback, health, and clean-state checks.

operations.name: document-layout
operations.description: Process text-layer sidecars, reading order, tables, footnotes, headers, equations, and layout anchors without image OCR.

operations.name: editing
operations.description: Measure readability, repetition, ambiguity, terminology consistency, and revision diffs without rewriting evidence.

operations.name: evaluation
operations.description: Run offline fixtures for retrieval, translation, terminology, factuality, transcript, and acceptance thresholds by language.

operations.name: evidence-review
operations.description: Plan reviews, screen records, build evidence tables, synthesize themes, map gaps, and apply inclusion gates.

operations.name: fact-check
operations.description: Extract claims, compare numeric/date facts with local evidence, detect conflicts and retractions, and calibrate uncertainty.

operations.name: governance
operations.description: Generate interface schemas, SOPs, quick starts, troubleshooting trees, training exercises, dependency graphs, and governance reports.

operations.name: human-review
operations.description: Create pending human-review records, track conflicts and comments, and enforce approval-gated actions.

operations.name: ingest
operations.description: Read local text, Markdown, copied HTML, JSONL, CSV, BibTeX, RIS, VTT, and SRT inputs into validated normalized source records.

operations.name: knowledge-graph
operations.description: Extract entities and relationships with bounded rules and export nodes, edges, and graph quality checks.

operations.name: legal-corpus
operations.description: Check jurisdiction, effective dates, repeals, amendments, legal versions, and legal provenance.

operations.name: localization-qa
operations.description: Check placeholders, numbers, dates, encoding, length, bidi controls, untranslated segments, and locale gates.

operations.name: news-archive
operations.description: Track news versions, corrections, syndication, event timelines, and archive acceptance.

operations.name: originality
operations.description: Detect exact and near passage overlap, quotation boundary issues, citation omissions, and self-similarity.

operations.name: packaging
operations.description: Build bounded offline ZIP handoffs, license and checksum inventories, install/self-test notes, backup, and recovery records.

operations.name: provenance
operations.description: Record checksums, versions, prompts, snapshots, audit events, evidence packages, drift, and reproducible run state.

operations.name: question-answering
operations.description: Decompose questions, retrieve evidence, produce extractive cited answers, detect conflicts, and abstain when unsupported.

operations.name: reference-corpus
operations.description: Validate reference editions, deduplicate records, and produce a general-knowledge corpus acceptance report.

operations.name: retrieval
operations.description: Build a local BM25-style index and run bounded Boolean, phrase, field, facet, date, language, and permission-aware search.

operations.name: rights
operations.description: Classify licenses, control quotation length, check attribution and redistribution permissions, and build rights evidence.

operations.name: scholarly-corpus
operations.description: Validate scholarly corpus metadata, peer-review status, corrections, retractions, and acceptance gates.

operations.name: security
operations.description: Classify sensitive data, scan for PII-like and secret-like patterns, prompt injection, restricted isolation, and export gates.

operations.name: semantic-retrieval
operations.description: Build deterministic local hashed n-gram vectors, run hybrid/vector search, rerank, calibrate thresholds, and detect drift.

operations.name: specialized-writing
operations.description: Render academic, technical, legal, policy, standards, and grant-style drafts from the same grounded evidence.

operations.name: standards-library
operations.description: Check standards editions, supersession, normative references, requirement clauses, and license audits.

operations.name: terminology
operations.description: Validate, extract, apply, and audit glossaries, do-not-translate terms, and translation memories.

operations.name: translation
operations.description: Apply configurable local translation memory and glossary drafting, preserve placeholders and numbers, and flag human review.
